    On the Board
      Project Board

      Add responses above, then project this board for discussion.

      Click a response on the board to enlarge just that one for the room; click it again to go back to the grid.

      Quick Tally

      Project this tab and have students tap the number that matches how they feel right now — a fast, anonymous whole-class pulse check. Works on a shared classroom device or as a front-of-room tap-in.

      0 responses

      Tally by Category

      A second way to tally, for reading a stack of papers and sorting as you go — e.g. “12 got it, 9 partial, 7 confused.” Rename a category by editing its label, tap a tile once per paper, and use Save & Reset when you start a new class or a new day — each save logs a dated snapshot below so you can compare classes over time.

      Layout

      Students scan this to submit their answer digitally, in addition to (or instead of) writing on the slip.

      Draws distinct prompts from whatever category / My Prompts settings are active on the Prompt & Display tab — handy for handing one prompt per table group instead of the whole class getting the same one.
